page0.text:
...
The laughter draws near.
As soon as I try pushing myself up, lightning courses through my spine.
The pain screams through every fiber of my being that I can't fight anymore.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-03:page0:1

page1.text:
...
I can't get up.
Even if I could, I'm too much of a mess. I can't beat him.
And in that moment of realization, my body, so hell-bent on survival, finally gives up.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-03:page1:1

page2.text: The power that had been protecting me all this time fades.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-03:page2:1
